title: Proof of Categorical self-duality
html:
By the Bogomolny decomposition in the dagger category,

  \int_A(F_
abla^* \cdot F_
abla)
  =  2\int_A({F_
abla^-}^* \cdot F_
abla^-)
        + \int_A(F_
abla \wedge_q F_
abla),

where the second term is topological (determined by the class [F_ abla] \in \Omega^2(A)/\mathrm{exact}). Minimising S[ abla] forces F_ abla^- = 0, which is exactly the self-duality condition.
